environment.description: Application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Flask runs directly via gunicorn with default settings. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener on port 80 forwarding to instance port 8080
